item: Status probe detached only from a queue or null pool: main's three red tests fixed
summary: #1289 detached the status probe's connection from every pool; on a StaticPool or SingletonThreadPool (an in-memory test engine) the one pooled connection IS the database, so the next checkout opened a new empty :memory: database and three tests failed with no such table on main. insights._detachable now detaches only a QueuePool or NullPool (the app only builds ReservingQueuePool: production unchanged). Two tests pin both halves; each mutant fails one. Found by the coordinator's reading check of #1289.
